replacements.Escala de entrenamiento y cómputo en inf: Training scale and inference compute: two distinct axes
replacements.Más parámetros y más tiempo de razonamie: More parameters and more reasoning time improve performance in different, complementary ways. Cost no longer depends only on model size.
replacements.Coste que se paga una vez. Determina qué: A cost paid once. It determines what knowledge and capabilities are encoded in the model weights.
replacements.Límite: rendimiento converge con datos y: Limit: performance converges with data and parameters (Chinchilla scaling curves)
replacements.Coste que se paga en cada consulta. Perm: A cost paid on every query. It lets the model review, verify and refine before answering.
replacements.Más tokens de razonamiento → más pasos d: More reasoning tokens → more verification steps
replacements.Límite: overthinking, coste por consulta: Limit: overthinking, rising per-query cost and latency
replacements.Ninguno de los dos ejes por sí solo prod: Neither axis alone produces optimal performance. Combining both is what pushes benchmarks toward expert-level results.
replacements.Un modelo pequeño con mucho TTC puede su: A small model with a large TTC budget can outperform a large model with little TTC on reasoning tasks. That changes architecture decisions: instead of always buying more training capacity, you can also buy more inference budget.
replacements.Consensus vote con 64 trazas · máximo TT: Consensus vote with 64 traces · maximum TTC
replacements.De GPT-4o a o1 (mismo laboratorio, más r: From GPT-4o to o1 (same lab, more reasoning): +61 pp on AIME 2024
replacements.De o1×1 a o1×64: +9 pp adicionales con e: From o1×1 to o1×64: +9 additional pp with the same model and more search
replacements.s1-32B supera a o1-preview (44,6%) con s: s1-32B outperforms o1-preview (44.6%) with only 1,000 examples and 26 minutes of fine-tuning
replacements.Fuentes: OpenAI o1 System Card (2024) ·: Sources: OpenAI o1 System Card (2024) · Muennighoff et al. (2025) arXiv:2501.19393 · Rein et al. (2023) GPQA
replacements.El cambio en la curva de coste: The shift in the cost curve
replacements.El coste de una respuesta era proporcion: The cost of an answer was proportional to model size. Larger models → more expensive on every query alike.
replacements.El coste depende de la combinación: mism: Cost depends on the combination: the same model has variable per-query cost depending on the assigned reasoning budget.
replacements.Decisiones que cambian con esta lógica: Decisions that change under this logic
replacements.La elección del modelo ya no es suficien: Choosing the model is no longer enough. You also need to specify the TTC budget for each query type. A 7B model with a high budget can outperform a 70B model with a minimal budget on reasoning tasks.
replacements.Con TTC variable, la factura de inferenc: With variable TTC, inference cost is no longer flat. Without hard per-query budgets, a complex question can cost 3–10× more than a simple one in the same system.
